questions.q: In LOCAL_NED a 10 m climb is Z = …
What happens if the companion stops sending velocity targets?
options: It keeps flying at the last velocity
It cuts the motors and falls
questions.explain: GUID_TIMEOUT (3 s by default) is protection you rely on, not work around.

questions.q: How often do you send velocity targets?
questions.explain: Within the timeout, even if the target has not changed.

questions.q: The pilot switched the mode from GUIDED to LOITER. What must the code do?
options: Switch back to GUIDED with a command
questions.explain: The code must respect the pilot.

questions.q: The vehicle stops before reaching the target. What is the likely cause?
options: The geofence or the WP_* limits (before 4.7, WPNAV_*)
Too low a P gain in the velocity loop in GUIDED
questions.explain: This is the FC's protection; check FENCE_* and the messages.

questions.q: Where do you run offboard code first?
options: On the bench with the props on
questions.explain: The same code, the same port, only the address.
Bits 0–2 (position), 6–8 (acceleration), 10–11 (yaw, yaw rate) = ignore; bit 9 (force) is set too, and ArduPilot does not use it.
